decisions.question: Who is the controller, and what legal basis applies to each purpose in purposes.json?
What adult age threshold applies in each recruitment region, and how is the self-declaration worded?
What maximum retention applies to each class in retention.json, including the consent ledger after account deletion?
May aggregate benchmark statistics that included a withdrawn specimen be kept, or must releases be rebuilt?
Approve the final participant notice and consent wording in Swedish and English (the drafts are not legal text).
Approve the pilot collection agreement covering derived statistics, retention, deletion and withdrawal channel.
Decide whether and how participants are compensated, independent of sharing, contribution or results.
Approve recruitment channels that avoid relying only on the founder's network or one institution.
Approve the storage/processing providers and regions used for pilot images and annotations.
Decide who may annotate, under what confidentiality terms, and how access is logged and revoked.
Confirm the project owns and may use the original collection prompts in content/collection/v1.

blocked_until_approved: Collecting, uploading or annotating any pilot handwriting.
Activating notice.pilot-collection or any consent capture UI for pilot purposes.
Admitting any specimen to a reference candidate set.
